headword: {通信販売|つうしんはんばい}

definitions.explanation: a method of selling goods or services where orders are placed remotely, by mail, phone, internet, or other means, without face-to-face interaction

examples.japanese: {通信販売|つうしんはんばい}で{本|ほん}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a book through mail order.

examples.japanese: {通信販売|つうしんはんばい}の{利用者|りようしゃ}が{年々|ねんねん}{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: The number of mail-order customers is increasing year by year.

examples.japanese: この{会社|かいしゃ}は{通信販売|つうしんはんばい}を{中心|ちゅうしん}に{事業|じぎょう}を{展開|てんかい}している。
examples.english: This company is developing its business primarily through mail-order sales.

notes:
A formal compound of {通信|つうしん} (communication) and {販売|はんばい} (sales). This is the official, legal term for any form of remote commerce. Often abbreviated to {通販|つうはん} in everyday conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通信販売|つうしんはんばい}で{買|か}う: to buy through mail order
- {通信販売|つうしんはんばい}{業者|ぎょうしゃ}: mail-order business
- {通信販売|つうしんはんばい}{法|ほう}: the Act on Specified Commercial Transactions (governing distance selling)

FORMS:
{通販|つうはん} is the widely used shortened form and is much more common in daily conversation. The full form {通信販売|つうしんはんばい} appears in official, legal, and business contexts.

RELATED WORDS:
- {通販|つうはん}: mail order (abbreviation) — the everyday short form
- ネット{通販|つうはん}: online shopping — specifically internet-based
- {店頭販売|てんとうはんばい}: over-the-counter sales — selling at a physical store
